notes: Three manuals: the Positiv is mapped to Cecilia's Choir division (MIDI channel 4). Two expression shoes: Swell, and Great-Positiv-Pedal.
The Great Tremulant also affects the Pedal.
Not included: MIDI on <division>, Melody/Bass Coupler, Tremulants Full, Alternate Tuning, unenclosed and speaker controls.

Check on your organ: Allen channels follow the MIDI base channel (Swell = base channel, Great +1, Pedal +2, Choir +3; general pistons on channel 8). The base channel resets to 1 at power-on, so these channels normally apply.

Expression: in the default POLY-VOLUME mode each division's channel carries Control Change 7 (volume) from its expression shoe; Allen's minimum is about 20. If the organ is set to SWELL-VOLUME, POLY-VELOCITY or NO EXPRESSION the Great/Pedal (and Choir) volumes will not be recorded.

Stops are not bound: Allen sends and receives each stop as an NRPN (CC99 MSB, CC98 LSB, then CC6 127 = on / 0 = off, on the division's channel), which Cecilia's single-message bindings cannot express. A future NRPN driver is needed; 'Learn every stop' cannot tell Allen stops apart because every stop ends with the same CC6 message.
The organ's 'Transmit/Receive Stops' MIDI setting must be ON for stop changes to be sent or received at all.
Stop list: https://www.allenorgan.com/support/ownersmanuals/MDS-39OwnersManual.pdf (MDS-39 owner's manual, 'MDS-39 Stoplist' Section I p.3-7; scanned)

MIDI scheme: https://www.allenorgan.com/support/ownersmanuals/033-00086ChamberConsoleController.pdf (Chamber Series Console Controller and MIDI Guide: standard classical channels Swell 1, Great 2, Pedal 3, Choir 4, Solo 5, generals 8, p.15; Poly-Volume expression p.16; Transmit/Receive Stops (NRPN) p.18; MIDI OUT 1 unswitched / OUT 2 switched p.22)

MIDI scheme: https://www.allenorgan.com/support/ownersmanuals/033-00266TH317eTheatreOwnersManual.pdf (TH-317e owner's manual, Appendix B p.18-19: volume = Control Change 7, lower limit about 20; stops = NRPN CC99/CC98 then CC6 127 on / 0 off; pistons = Program Changes)
